about: Micah was a prophet who told what God wants from us, and that a king would be born in Bethlehem.

pages.title: What God Wants
pages.scene: A person walking with a child on a path
pages.text: People asked, "What gift does God want? Lots of animals? Rivers of oil?" Micah said, "God has shown you what is good: Do what is fair. Love being kind. Walk humbly with your God."
pages.lesson: Be fair, be kind and walk with God.

pages.title: Little Bethlehem
pages.scene: The little town of Bethlehem on a hill
pages.text: Micah said, "Bethlehem, you are a small town. But a great ruler will come from you. He will take care of His people like a shepherd." Many years later, Jesus was born in Bethlehem!
pages.lesson: God does big things through small places.
